release_notes: Added three winning legacies: Crown Keep, World Tree, and Arcane Spire, supported by new Bastion, Guildhall, Grand Bazaar, and Mage Tower branches.
Runs now begin with a seeded Hearth, Wild, or Guild opening. Magical terrain grants affinity bonuses, while Royal Charters award renown and additional redraws.
Added salvage mode for recovering occupied squares, addressing the repeated invalid-placement frustration seen in the playtest.

Replaced primitive models with 16 authored building sprites, four illustrated terrain types, and an enchanted valley backdrop. Merge feedback now includes sprite pops, particles, flashes, camera shake, streak messaging, and synthesized chimes.
Rebuilt the right-side guide around readable legacy routes, charters, and core recipes. Building labels remain removed; fullscreen and keyboard shortcuts remain available.
Expanded deterministic logic tests and added a real main-scene test covering asset loading, UI construction, merging, rendering state, and salvage.

Validation passed: `npm test` and `npm run build` both exit 0, producing the complete Web export. Browser smoke could not run because this container lacks its configured Chromium binary; native main-scene validation covers runtime script failures.

Asset generation report — generate mode. [Buildings](/home/waynechi/dev/async-gamedev/game/assets/buildings-atlas.png): “Create sixteen commercial-quality fantasy settlement sprites in an exact ordered 4×4 isometric atlas.” [Terrain](/home/waynechi/dev/async-gamedev/game/assets/terrain-atlas.png): “Create an exact 2×2 atlas containing Meadow, magical Spring, rune Ruins, and Festival Plaza.” [Backdrop](/home/waynechi/dev/async-gamedev/game/assets/enchanted-valley.png): “Create a wide enchanted valley backdrop with waterfalls, ruins, mist, and a calm board-readable center.” A transparent-background edit was attempted but rejected because it baked a checkerboard; the accepted building atlas was mechanically alpha-keyed without altering its sprites.
